reply.text:
Straps are a reasonable tool here, and it's a common story: grip fails before the back is actually taxed. The usual approach is to train grip on its own, with heavy holds, dead hangs and farmer carries, so the back gets the load it's supposed to. Use straps on your heaviest working sets where grip is the only limit, and keep most of your lighter sets strap-free so your grip keeps developing.

If you want, I can pull your deadlift history to see how far grip is actually holding you back before we decide how much strap work to use.
